eligibility.quote: it appears that the formula got copied wrong from Wikipedia, as applying the absolute-value function in the place it was at prevented detection of the long-way-around case.

notes: Issue #1478 ("Floating joint interpolation takes the long way around") reports a wrong interpolation value from moveit::core::FloatingJointModel::interpolate. I read the issue body (reproducer with fjm.interpolate(jv1, jv2, 0.5, intp) and "Note how the interpolated angle has value 0.285: it's taking the long way around, with the interpolation going through 0 instead of Pi/-Pi radians.") and PR #1479 ("Fixed fabs() use in quaternion interpolation", body quoted above, merged 2022-08-09). The defect is wrong arithmetic inside one library function; any correct caller receives the wrong result, and the reporter calls the function directly (no two-unit composition). E2 stops at step 2 (internal), which is correct. Loudness/resolution correctly null.
